Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusDepot01]:
This compact depot fuels, maintains and stores buses. Each vehicle stops at certain intervals for maintenance to stay in running order.
Can be upgraded to support electric buses.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusDepo: Enables the depot to send out electric buses. The types of buses operating on a line can be changed on each individual line's Bus Line panel.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusInte:
An integrated bus station that allows direct bus traffic to and from the station.
Is available with multiple pedestrian shelter designs with the same layout.

A small integrated bus station that allows direct bus traffic to and from the station.
The station is available with multiple pedestrian shelter designs with the same layout.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusStation01]:
A small sunken terminal for buses. The above-grade concourse allows direct access to the bus without crossing over traffic.
Fuels, maintains and stores two buses which return at intervals to stay in running order.
The station is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusStation02]:
A large sunken terminal for buses. The above-grade concourse allows direct access to the bus without crossing over traffic.
The station is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout and acts as a plaza for locals.
Can be upgraded with extra platforms and a subway interface.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusStat: Adds more platforms to the station, allowing for increased capacity.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusStation03]:
A large sunken and unique terminal for buses. The above-grade concourse allows direct access to the bus without crossing over traffic and acts as a plaza for locals.
Fuels, maintains and stores buses which return to stay in running order.
Can be upgraded with extra platforms and a subway interface.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusStat: Adds more platforms to the station, allowing for increased capacity.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-BusStop01]: A beautifully designed bus stop that offers improved comfort for waiting passengers, increasing the desirability of taking the bus.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-ClockTower01]: A modern, architectural clock tower for your city. Can be placed freely or as a centerpiece to a roundabout.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-Overpas: Adds a staircase to the center of the overpass, allowing access to divided roads with widened medians.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-Overpass01]:
A small overpass allowing pedestrians an alternative from on-street crossings. 
Best suited for small roads or smaller.
Provides slight outdoor entertainment for citizens who like to sit and watch traffic.
Can be placed above roads.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-Overpass02]:
A medium overpass allowing pedestrians an alternative from on-street crossings.
Best suited for medium roads or smaller. 
Provides slight outdoor entertainment for citizens who like to sit and watch traffic.
Can be placed above roads and upgraded with a median staircase.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-Overpass03]:
A large overpass allowing pedestrians an alternative from on-street crossings.
Best suited for large roads or smaller. 
Provides slight outdoor entertainment for citizens who like to sit and watch traffic.
Can be placed above roads and upgraded with a median staircase.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-Overpass04]:
An extra-large overpass allowing pedestrians an alternative from on-street crossings.
Best suited for extra-large roads or smaller. 
Provides slight outdoor entertainment for citizens who like to sit and watch traffic.
Can be placed above roads and upgraded with a median staircase.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-RailYard01]: A compact complex used for the storing, sorting and maintenance of trains. Can be upgraded with extra tracks.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-RailYar: Increased capacity for more trains. Place alongside the Compact Rail Yard or within the radius given.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayI: An extension that connects to the subway network. Works as a subway station and is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayStation01: Allows passengers access to subway platforms below ground and acts as a plaza for locals. Available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout, it can be upgraded with extra, perpendicular platforms and a small integrated bus terminal.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayS: Increased capacity for more subway trains and built beneath and perpendicular to the existing tracks.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayStation02:
Allows access to elevated subway platforms, and is placed perpendicular to the road.
The outer tracks bypass trains stopping at the island platform and is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout.
Can be upgraded with a small integrated bus terminal and extra platforms.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayS: Increased capacity for more subway trains and built on the outer tracks, transforming the station from a bypass station to a four-platform station.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayStation03:
Just like a metro plaza station, except subways - right?
This unique landmark subway station serves the city with a multi-platform hub while acting as a large city park.
While sunken, don't worry it has good drainage so it won't flood!
Can be upgraded with an architectural roof and extra platforms.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayS: Install this roof above the sunken subway park to improve comfort for waiting passengers, increasing the station’s appeal, making it more likely to be used by citizens.
Sacrificing the open park, this adds a lower deck with eight platforms to increase subway capacity. While park attractiveness is reduced, it still functions as a more limited plaza.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayYard01]:
A compact yard that handles subway train maintenance and storage. It has a ground and tunnel connection on opposite ends of the lot.
Additionally functions as a small parking facility for locals.
Can be upgraded with extra tracks.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-SubwayY: Increased capacity for more subway trains.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TrainStation01]:
Services passenger trains on sunken platforms. The inside tracks bypass trains stopping at the outer platforms and is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout.
Can be upgraded with an integrated bus terminal, subway interface and island platform.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TrainSt: Increased capacity for more passenger trains and built on the inside tracks, transforming the station from a bypass station to a four-platform station.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TrainStation02]:
Services passenger trains on elevated platforms. The inside tracks bypass trains stopping at the outer platforms and is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout.
Can be upgraded with an integrated bus terminal, subway interface and island platform.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TrainSt: Increased capacity for more passenger trains and built on the inside tracks, transforming the station from a bypass station to a four-platform station.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TrainStation03]:
With sunken platforms, this terminal anchors your downtown. Featuring an iconic roof, pedestrian suspension bridge - it acts as a city plaza and has an integrated rail yard for the storing and maintenance of trains.
Can be upgraded with a tunnel link, subway interface and a huge botanical gardens.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TrainSt: Adds tunnel connections to each track, passing below the main entrance and road, converting the station from a terminus to a through station.

Featuring an architectural greenhouse, this sprawling botanical gardens spans above rail yard, linking to the pedestrian bridge and offers paths criss-crossing the park from one side to the other. Lastly, above the rail yard tunnel entrance, Chillon Plaza is where the trainspotters hangout.

An extensions that connects to the subway network. Works as a subway station and is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout. This subway interface connects directly to the pedestrian bridge, and then to the main concourse by a staircase.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TramDepot01]:
Compact workshops and staff facilities for the tram network. Trams return to the depot for maintenance at regular intervals.
Can be upgraded with an extra tram shed.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TramDep: Space for more trams in a newly built shed.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TramStation01]:
A small plaza station for trams. The plaza allows open space to congregate and wide platforms for passengers.
The station is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout and acts as a plaza for locals.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TramStation02]:
A large plaza station for trams. The plaza allows open space to congregate and wide platforms for passengers.
The station is available with multiple architectural designs with the same layout and acts as a plaza for locals.
Can be upgraded to include an open-sky tram yard.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TramSta: Stores and maintains trams which return to the depot for maintenance at regular intervals.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TramStation03]:
A unique, landmark tram plaza with enough capacity for the center of your city. Architecturally designed with a hall for passengers to eat and relax in while they wait for their trams.
Can be upgraded with a subway interface.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack7-TramStop01]: A beautifully designed tram stop that offers improved comfort for waiting passengers, increasing the desirability of taking the tram.
